changelog: The mentee is notified when their certificate is issued (#1410): `POST /api/mentorship/[id]/certificate` sends `certificate.issued` (catalogue entry, `mentorship` preference, no params) linked to `/portal/journey`, where `PortalCertificateCard` downloads it. A reference letter notifies nobody — the card shows the certificate only.

en: You now get a notification as soon as your certificate is ready to download.
tr: Katılım belgen indirilebilir hale gelir gelmez artık bildirim alıyorsun.
de: Du wirst jetzt benachrichtigt, sobald dein Zertifikat zum Download bereitsteht.
